cases.rationale: A short light walk satisfies the prototype's low-intensity constraints.
Light-moderate intensity is within the standard maximum.
Exactly 90% of availability is still within the explicit duration budget.
Moderate exceeds the low-intensity target; a lower-intensity revision may be released.
Initial intensity and time both exceed the fixture constraints; repair must satisfy both.
The repaired plan must fit a ten-minute availability window and lower intensity.
Vigorous initial advice is outside this prototype's scope and requires fallback, not release.
A light ten-minute candidate meets the stricter Recovery constraints.
Non-light initial advice in Recovery violates the hard rule; personalized output must be withheld.
Red-flag input requires a support notice, regardless of benign candidate content.
Warning-sign input requires a support notice rather than a personalized exercise plan.
No active review policy means personalized advice must fail closed.
A candidate based on an obsolete profile cannot be released.
No model candidate is available; all modes must return without personalized advice.
A valid low-intensity plan is desired, but the injected revision outage prevents completion. This deliberately counts as an eligible task failure.
